biome: temperate forest (flat, tile 39, 11.8 C at landing, rainfall 1867mm, swampiness 0, pollution 0; 91/91 surrounding tiles temperate forest, 79 flat)
notes: Adviser run (arm on), played by the human. Set up by agent via MCP (scenario/storyteller/tile 39/ideology/colonist selection), colony landed, then the player took over. Reached the full 11-day limit with all 3 colonists alive at 100 HP and none downed. Outcome: survived the run, but the colony ended in Starvation (2.2 days of food) with Steven Wilcox's mood at 17% (major break risk). Wealth 24364. 1 urgent alert (enemy downed during a raid on 11th of Aprimay), 1 auto-pause, 1 reflex snapshot. Research: Batteries 44% at end (7 completed / 164 total). Final alerts: Need batteries, Archaka role unfilled, Trader, Starvation, Major break risk. Food trend: 7.2 days (Day 1) -> 3.5 (Day 3) -> 5.3 (Day 6) -> 4.2 (Day 8) -> 2.5 (Day 10) -> 1.5 (Day 10 night) -> 2.2 (end); a rice harvest landed on 1st of Jugust (food 15 -> 205) but the colony still ate through it. 18 wall construction sites sat unbuilt for 3+ days ('Need defenses' alert from 9th of Aprimay). Quests: Beggars Seek Aid (EndedSuccess), Mechanoid Signal (Ongoing), The Fleeing Knight (accepted by Kaleun, EndedOfferExpired). Colony renamed 'Ereston', faction 'Alliance of Doroeron'. A ibex doe gave birth and Steven tamed an ibex ram.
